warning: Quantization-only worksheet, not metrological conformity, calibration or production-release certification. Assumes nearest-increment rounding of a fixed unchanged quantity with no other error; closed bins conservatively retain tie endpoints. Resolution is declared rounding increment, NOT standard uncertainty or instrument accuracy. Intersect only readings of the same specimen/feature under compatible conditions. Correlated repeats cannot remove systematic bias. No inference of numeric readings, units or specimen identity from text; these need manual review. No automatic conversion, error averaging, statistical confidence, safety decision or physical action. Baseline uses the last approved reading point in source order and ignores quantization. Counts are computed, not accuracy/time-savings claims. Holds remain in audit, excluded from intervals.
